question: Should assistant-message plain-text copy be implemented as an inline Markdown/plain-text copy menu, a persisted default-copy-format preference, or a smaller one-shot plain-text action?
rationale: Current code can support a narrow UI change, but the issue explicitly offers alternate UX shapes and the conversion semantics affect user expectations for code blocks, links, tables, and lists.

options.title: Copy menu
options.body: Add a compact copy button menu with Copy as Markdown and Copy as Plain Text actions, leaving future preference work separate.

options.title: Persisted preference
options.body: Add a default copy-format preference and keep the button as a single action, accepting a new user-setting surface.

options.title: No core change
options.body: Keep the existing Markdown-only copy behavior and close the request as product-out-of-scope.

recommendation.title: Copy menu
recommendation.body: Add a compact copy button menu with Copy as Markdown and Copy as Plain Text actions, leaving future preference work separate.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the original copy-as-markdown behavior and have recent adjacent Control UI chat maintenance history.
